authority.runtime_authority: verifier.py verify is the only experiment-facing surface; this contract is descriptive and grants no dispatch or repair authority

semantic manifest routes schedule cells and every declared file hash and byte count
schedule.json exact slot-major product and routes.json exact route identity
semantic inventory receipt hashes byte counts and per-cell render and expected-output bindings
run kind mode row count route cell ordinal 64-hex nonce and exact selected schedule
exact run root directory inventory with no symlinks special paths extra files missing files or future-row evidence
provider_input.txt exact render storage bytes and exact provider-visible render-minus-terminal-LF hash and byte bindings
one attempt only zero retry zero best-of zero replacement and permanent invalidity of any attempted row without a valid completion
full backend terminal core identity route nonce input output process and dispatch accounting
actual derived task identity exact route model effort attestation raw final-message binding rollout digest output capture terminal process and prohibited-activity evidence when published
strict JSON response parsing and deterministic exact canonical expected_output plus one-LF score recomputation
completion-last structural seal and exact completion score binding
contiguous completed prefix including valid ordered-stop prefixes and complete canary matrix and synthetic runs
exact path terminal matrix terminal and accounting recomputation
global cross-run task thread turn and nonce uniqueness across the evidence root

run-canary.selected_rows: manifest canary_cell once per route in route order

nonclaims: No provider subject or network call is made.
No candidate v12 through v21 controller verifier or process module is imported or executed.
No evidence is written repaired deleted renamed or resumed.
A valid synthetic run is zero-credit simulator evidence and is not empirical or qualification evidence.
Verifier validity is not a preseal audit freeze canary qualification production-readiness release-readiness or safety-certification claim.
residuals: Reflection resistance capability-token confinement callback confinement and hostile in-process caller resistance are explicitly out of scope and nonblocking.
A final filesystem snapshot can validate exact bytes paths and bindings but cannot independently reconstruct historical O_EXCL or fsync system calls; those remain trusted-controller obligations.
